Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety review. The change affects which post text generates G-code.

Requested before merge:

1. [crates/app/src/session_files.rs:62](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/17e6d6b35057205a75dd960abcb94b76357499cf/crates/app/src/session_files.rs#L62) — Keep the selected post stable when a folder adds a file with the same name. `add_post` replaces the stored text. The post reference and history stay unchanged. A temporary check kept the same `PostRef` and generated `G21` before the load, then `G20` after it. Picking the selected name also replaces its text before the command refuses the unchanged reference. Refuse different text under an existing name, or make replacement undoable. Add a test for the same-name folder case.

2. [crates/ui/src/file_pick.rs:288](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/17e6d6b35057205a75dd960abcb94b76357499cf/crates/ui/src/file_pick.rs#L288) — Bound the aggregate browser read size before reading a batch. The 256 MiB guard applies to each file. This loop retains every byte buffer until all reads finish. Seventeen allowed files require 4.25 GiB for raw bytes alone. That exceeds the wasm32 address space and can abort before validation. The multi-file drop has the same pattern at `setup_file_drop.rs:74`. Add a batch budget and a budget for retained session text. Refuse excess input by name. Add a test for a batch of individually allowed files. This finding comes from source and size bounds; no allocation stress test was run.

3. [crates/ui/src/state_picked.rs:178](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/17e6d6b35057205a75dd960abcb94b76357499cf/crates/ui/src/state_picked.rs#L178) — Invalidate the machine catalogue after a successful machine import. Folder loads keep the mount path and leave `machines_pane.list` populated. `machines_pane::refresh` therefore keeps the old catalogue. A temporary check found the new file through `library::enumerate`, but the displayed catalogue stayed stale. Pressing Refresh makes the file appear. Add a test with a catalogue that was populated before the folder load.

4. [crates/app/src/session_files.rs:21](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/17e6d6b35057205a75dd960abcb94b76357499cf/crates/app/src/session_files.rs#L21) — Move the pure storage and file readers to their domain crate. This production module reads no ECS world, project file, command, MCP, or CLI. It stores strings and validates machine/post values. This breaks upstream AGENTS.md, “app holds the document, nothing else”. Pass checks from app to the domain code where necessary.

5. [crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_page.rs:204](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/17e6d6b35057205a75dd960abcb94b76357499cf/crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_page.rs#L204) — Add before/after screenshots of the Machine and Post pages to the PR body. The body has none. Show the new folder button and the enabled load buttons. Store the images only on the fork’s images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body.

The existing commands still handle new machine mounts and post choices. The new UI tests and named refusals pass.

All checks ran locally on the trial merge with upstream/main at `69c9fd7af7f3777d0891eab842aeb0773d2a4f1c`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Quick selection | 420 app steps passed; 19 UI steps passed on retry. All 439 selected steps passed. |
| App unit tests | 298 passed. |
| UI unit tests | 1411 passed; 7 ignored. All six new browser setup-file tests passed. |
| Clippy | `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed. |
| Heavy lanes | `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 203 of 204 steps passed in the full run. The `large_models` timing test failed at 88.10 seconds; its isolated retry passed (18.85 seconds for the suite). |
| Goldens | None changed. |

The UI run passed on retry after a stalled compiler cache was restarted. The full heavy gate returned failure. Its only unexpected failure passed on retry without a source change. The timing test and import code are unchanged by this PR.

Extra suites run:

- Temporary `review3160_session_post` app checks confirmed the two post pins. A separate negative check reproduced the selected-post replacement.
- The temporary UI check `review_3160_folder_load_refreshes_cached_catalogue` reproduced the stale catalogue.
- `large_models::ten_million_facets_stream_under_the_wall`, release, ignored: isolated retry passed (1 passed).
- The fixture/importer extra-suite conditions do not apply to this diff.

Mutation checks:

| Mutation | With mutation | After restoration |
|---|---|---|
| Use disk reads in `posting::script_of` and `resolve_cps` | The session-reader pin failed by file name. | Passed. |
| Remove the compile/run check from `session_files::add_post` | The bad-syntax pin failed because the file was accepted. | Passed. |

Both mutations ran together. Each failed a separate app check. Both checks passed after restoration. All temporary review code was removed.

Limits: The wasm32 target is absent. The wasm-only chooser and drop code was not compiled. A real browser was not exercised.

Non-blocking note: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs` grows from 471 to 473 lines. It already exceeds the 400-line guideline.

- A file is checked before the session keeps it. A machine must parse. A post must compile and run on an empty stream. The script engine has its loop, recursion and stack limits, so a hostile script cannot hang the app.
